name: Sable Odinga-Nakamura-Valenzuela

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (75.9%) with significant East Asian (11.4%) and Hispanic/Latin American (10.0%) ancestry, plus trace Southeast Asian (2.7%). This blend produces rich warm brown undertones with subtle amber and golden notes—a deep, warm bronze complexion reflecting his strong African genetic foundation, enriched by East Asian bone structure and Latin American warmth.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and thick-necked, muscular but softened by age and desk work. Carries weight in his torso; forearms remain corded and strong.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with residual black at the temples
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with deep gray shot through the iris
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm bronze with amber and golden undertones; weathered from decades of varied climates and urban exposure. Reflects Sub-Saharan African dominance with East Asian and Latin American warmth creating subtle richness in the hue.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, broad jawline with balanced angularity and rounded fullness reflecting his diverse ancestry—African width and prominence softened by East Asian and Latin American contours. Lines around the eyes and mouth from decades of negotiation and command. Slight scar tissue on his left cheekbone. Five o'clock shadow across a face that carries both angular and rounded features. Meticulous grooming otherwise.
distinguishing_marks: Thin horizontal scar across his left cheekbone, approximately 3cm, from a knife fight in his thirties
Network of pale burn scars across his right shoulder and upper arm, partially obscured by clothing
Tattoo on his inner left wrist: a Scandinavian rune (ᚦ, Thurisaz) in faded black ink, likely 30+ years old
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Military-grade smartwatch on right wrist with discrete Arcturus corporate logo. Slight neural port scarring behind right ear, barely visible unless hair is pulled back.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy—no wasted motion. Stands with shoulders squared, a habit from military life. Handshakes are firm and brief. Leans back when listening, eyes narrow slightly when calculating.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 1-2 corporate military aesthetic: charcoal wool slacks, pressed crisply; gray or black dress shirts with reinforced polymer weave (ballistic-rated). Dark tactical jacket (Arcturus-branded, understated embroidery). Black leather combat boots, polished to mirror finish. Small Φ currency clip on belt.
